crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”
“When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their…
but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things…

translations.web: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”
translations.bsb: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform signs with it.”
translations.kjv: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
translations.asv: And thou shalt take in thy hand this rod, wherewith thou shalt do the signs.
